title: FreshFood API 1.0
description: Frozen V1 public models. Optional input fields normalize to documented defaults. Domain validators additionally enforce conditional requirements. Any object-valued evidence/audit payload is read-only; clients must never derive eligibility from it.

UserSupplementSpec.title: UserSupplementSpec
UserSupplementSpec.description: Structural API contract. SupplementInputValidator additionally enforces physical mass, species, nutrient units and forms, serving conversion, chemical rules, label guidance, quality consistency and practical dispensing. Convenience nutrient fields are accepted as alternatives to active_components, never duplicates.
